## 5. Interfaces

- **s_axil_*** - AXI4-Lite slave, address [4:0], 32-bit data.

| Port | Dir | Width | Group | Built when | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aclk` | input | 1 | - | - | - |
| `aresetn` | input | 1 | - | - | - |
| `id_i` | input | [31:0] | - | - | ID (RO): value read by software |
| `id_wr_o` | output | 1 | - | - | ID: pulse on every software write |
| `ctrl_o` | output | [31:0] | - | - | CTRL (RW): register value |
| `ctrl_wr_o` | output | 1 | - | - | CTRL: pulse on every software write |
| `status_o` | output | [31:0] | - | - | STATUS (W1C): register value |
| `status_set_i` | input | [31:0] | - | - | STATUS: hardware sets bits (1 clock pulses) |
| `status_wr_o` | output | 1 | - | - | STATUS: pulse on every software write |
| `thresh_o` | output | [31:0] | - | - | THRESH (RW): register value |
| `thresh_wr_o` | output | 1 | - | - | THRESH: pulse on every software write |
| `count_i` | input | [31:0] | - | - | COUNT (RO): value read by software |
| `count_wr_o` | output | 1 | - | - | COUNT: pulse on every software write |
| `trig_o` | output | [31:0] | - | - | TRIG (W1S): register value |
| `trig_clr_i` | input | [31:0] | - | - | TRIG: hardware clears bits (1 clock pulses) |
| `trig_wr_o` | output | 1 | - | - | TRIG: pulse on every software write |

Back-pressure on every stream: honour tready, never drop data unless section 6 says so; valid must not depend combinationally on ready.

## 6. Function

Implement exactly this behaviour (from the reference design's specification):

```text
Generated AXI4-Lite register block 'demo_regs' with 6
registers (regmap_gen.py, do not edit by hand; regenerate from the JSON
description). Version 1.0.0. Built on axi4_lite_regs, so the timing is
the same. Clock - aclk. Reset - synchronous aresetn, registers take their
documented reset values. Latency - write 4 clocks, read 4 clocks. Errors
- writes to RO registers answer SLVERR, addresses beyond the last
register answer DECERR. Access types - RW read/write with byte strobes,
RO read only, W1C hardware sets and software clears by writing 1, W1S
software sets and hardware clears.
```

Describe and handle the edge cases, error recovery, latency and configuration-change rules stated above; where the text is silent, choose the safe option and document it in the file header.

### Register map (from `demo_regs.json`)

| Offset | Name | Access | Reset | Description | Fields |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | ID | RO | 0 | Block identifier | VALUE[31:0] Constant supplied by hardware |
| 0x04 | CTRL | RW | 0x00000010 | Control | EN[0] Enable; MODE[3:1] Operating mode; DIV[15:8] Clock divider |
| 0x08 | STATUS | W1C | 0 | Sticky status | DONE[0] Operation done; ERR[1] Error |
| 0x0C | THRESH | RW | 0x00000100 | Threshold | - |
| 0x10 | COUNT | RO | 0 | Live counter | - |
| 0x14 | TRIG | W1S | 0 | Software trigger bits, hardware clears when served | GO[0] Start |

The block is generated, not hand-written: write the JSON above and run `python3 ip/scripts/regmap_gen.py ip/examples/regmap/demo_regs.json`, which also emits the C header and Markdown documentation. Extend the generator rather than editing its output.


## 7. Implementation constraints

- Synthesizable SystemVerilog-2012, technology independent (no vendor primitives; infer RAM and DSP).
- Must work in iverilog 12+ (`-g2012`), Verilator lint (`-Wall`, no UNOPTFLAT or latches) and Yosys.
- iverilog limits: declare before use; no enum ternaries without casts; no `break`; no arrays of queues; no `wait` on function calls; no declarations inside nested loop bodies of static initial blocks.
- No combinational path from a ready input back to a ready output; hoist scratch variables (no latches); split control and data `always_ff` blocks.
- Resources: report the Yosys utilisation; keep it in line with similar library blocks.

## 9. Verification requirements

The reference testbench checks the following; the new testbench must cover at least the same:

- The reference design has no dedicated testbench; the block is exercised inside standalone library block. Write a self-checking testbench for it.

Also: an independent reference model (not a copy of the RTL); random input gaps and output back-pressure on every stream; register readback; edge cases; a mutation check (break one rule, show the testbench fails).

Pass criteria: `make -C examples/regmap test` passes, Verilator lint clean, `make synth` passes.

## 10. Report back

Files created, register map, test results (with the mutation check), synthesis resources, any change to existing IP and why, known limits.
